justification: A CI-blocking assertion plus a revived DB-backed check. Directionality: the assertion can only ADD a failure for an orphaned check, and the solar refactor is behaviour-identical. No served number changes.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Exits 1 when any scripts/{check,lint,verify,dq}_*.py is referenced by no workflow, no hook, no dq_checks.json entry and no other script, and is not in _UNWIRED_OK. Mutation-tested in the failing direction: removing check_registry.py from the allowlist made it exit 1 naming that file. It cannot be satisfied by silence - the allowlist sits in the diff and every entry must state a mechanism.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The wiring surface is read from the actual workflow and hook files on disk, not from a list anyone maintains. verify_coverage_stats compares against the live database, not a fixture.

pre_impl.existing_data: 7 orphaned checks found. Two revived, five allowlisted. verify_coverage_stats required PGHOST/PGPORT/PGDATABASE/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD, which nothing in the repo sets; it now reports all 6 published coverage stats current against the live DB. 562 DQ-32 rows measured for what actually distinguishes them: 556 carry a condition, 6 do not.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Two of mine failed. First, my earlier sweep of this same question read gates.yml and pre-push only, missed .githooks/pre-commit, and reported lint_bracket_access and lint_brief_failsoft as orphaned when both run on every commit. Second, I expected the 9 part-tagged DQ-32 groups to need more zone tags; every untagged row was separated by bedrooms, visitor parking, lot width, locality or former LGA instead, so tagging them would have deleted correct controls.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new file. The assertion is ~40 lines inside dq_check.py, which already runs in gates.yml - a separate check_the_checks.py would need its own wiring and begin the regress it is meant to end. verify_coverage_stats reuses dq_db.connect() rather than gaining its own connection logic.
pre_impl.external_source_error: verify_coverage_stats now returns 2, not 1, when the DB is unreachable: UNKNOWN is not 'the figures disagree'. Collapsing those turned main red (#939).

functions.name: unwired_checks
functions.what: Returns check-shaped scripts that no workflow, hook, dq_checks.json entry or other script invokes.
functions.output: list[str] of filenames, empty when everything is wired or allowlisted
functions.if_none: Empty list, and dq_check continues. Absence of orphans is the passing state.
functions.edge_cases: gates.yml invokes several from a shell loop that appends the extension, so the literal filename never appears; the scan matches the stem too. A script's own text is removed from the haystack so it cannot vouch for itself.
functions.failure_mode: Adds a false failure at worst, which is visible immediately. It cannot cause a wrong number to be served.

functions.name: _compute_confidence
functions.what: Derives the solar-yield confidence from coverage, a validated lot polygon and panel count.
functions.input: coverage_available: bool, has_lot_polygon: bool, max_panels: int (keyword-only)
functions.if_none: No coverage returns 'low' - absence is never reported as high confidence.
functions.edge_cases: An implausible polygon is demoted upstream, so 'high' cannot ride on a clip that never happened.
functions.failure_mode: Behaviour-identical to the inline branch it replaces; all 5 branches verified equal before and after.

break_it.scenario: Someone writes a new check and forgets to wire it, exactly as happened to campaign items 2-5.
break_it.what_happens: Previously nothing noticed for nine days, and the check could never earn blocking status.
break_it.how: dq_check.py now exits 1 in CI naming the file.

break_it.scenario: Someone silences the assertion by allowlisting everything.
break_it.what_happens: The guard becomes decorative: it still runs and still passes, while orphaned checks accumulate behind an allowlist nobody reads. That is the same shape as the original defect, only now with a green tick over it.
break_it.how: _UNWIRED_OK sits in the diff and each entry must give a mechanism; two entries here name the exact defect - own-connection code - that must be fixed before wiring.

break_it.scenario: The assertion itself is deleted from gates.yml - the regress objection, who checks the checker.
break_it.how: The scan includes itself, so removal means it either still runs and fails or gates.yml changed and the diff shows it; above that main-red-alarm.yml fires from outside the repo when main's HEAD has no successful run at all. Three levels, then it terminates.

break_it.scenario: The solar refactor changes a served confidence value.
break_it.what_happens: A confidence badge is itself a representation, so a changed one is a changed claim.
break_it.how: All 5 branch combinations evaluated against the original before and after, and matched.

break_it.scenario: verify_coverage_stats runs in CI where there is no DATABASE_URL.
break_it.what_happens: It would report the published marketing figures as disagreeing when it simply could not look.
break_it.how: Returns 2 (UNKNOWN), and the whole step is continue-on-error observation mode.

break_it.scenario: The 9 part-tagged DQ-32 groups get tagged zone_specific to drive the count down.
break_it.what_happens: Rows separated by bedroom count or visitor parking would be suppressed by zone, deleting correct controls.
break_it.how: Read all of them; none is zone-separated. Left untagged, and the finding recorded in the ledger.

verified: dq_check.py PASSED with the new assertion; mutation-tested to exit 1 when an allowlist entry is removed.
verify_coverage_stats.py: 6 of 6 published stats current against the live DB (it was exiting 1 on 'PGHOST').
solar _compute_confidence equal to the original on all 5 branch combinations; the lint prod category no longer contains solar_yield.
DQ-32 measured rather than asserted: 556 of 562 rows carry a discriminating condition, 6 do not.
gaps: check_registry.py and verify_controls_monitoring.py build their own connections and still cannot run; allowlisted with that as the reason, not fixed.
DB-backed checks report UNKNOWN in CI because CI has no DATABASE_URL. That is the standing blocker for the whole verification story in CI.
DQ-32 now needs a design ruling (present-all vs model-all). Not decided here.
43 of 56 ledger rows still have no check.

post_merge.db_reset: No migration, no schema change, no write of any kind. All DB access in this PR is read-only.
post_merge.secrets: None added. verify_coverage_stats now reads DATABASE_URL through dq_db.py instead of five PG* variables.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run python scripts/dq_check.py and confirm PASSED, then add an empty scripts/check_x.py and confirm it exits 1 naming that file. Read the 'Output grounding (OBSERVATION ONLY)' step in the next gates run on main - it now covers six checks.
